Transcription with verbose JSON response format including timestamp segments

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import CreateTranscriptionRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    request = CreateTranscriptionRequest.from_json("{\"file\":\"audio.mp3\",\"model\":\"whisper-1\",\"response_format\":\"verbose_json\"}")
    result = await client.transcribe(request)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
